title: readability: unix_secs_to_rfc3339 domain restriction not enforced in signature
description: kith-core/src/lib.rs unix_secs_to_rfc3339 doc says 'correct for dates from the Unix epoch (t=0) through 2299' but the parameter type is i64 and negative values are accepted silently. A reader calling this function with a value from an unknown source has no indication that negative input is undefined behavior. Fix: change the first doc line to explicitly say 'Panics or returns garbage for secs < 0' and add a debug_assert\!(secs >= 0) so tests catch violations in development.
